name: financeflow
description: FinanceFlow — personal finance & expense management dashboard (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
